reviews.text: Very nice shop, unfortunately only suitable for small dogs.
A great shop for pet lovers and beyond. Thank you for the conversation. I'll be adding photos of our purchase soon.

I stumbled upon this store while searching for dog supplies. First off, the dog leashes and capes are so cute and pretty. And the owner is incredibly kind. He's very interested in Korea, so we chatted a lot. It was a truly special experience. Finally, he told me to come by anytime if I had any issues while in Barcelona. 🥹 I was so touched. 🥹
They sell leashes for cats as well as dogs, so if you have a pet, stop by! 🥰
Nice store, but no pet food.
If you want your dog to look super cool, don't miss this place!
Thank you Rocío for your wonderful service! My dogs and I were so happy! A perfect experience!
Great if you have money and want bling for your pets!!
Fun and cute shop for dogs and cats

I bought two collars and a leash. It's impossible to go in there and not buy something. The shop is beautiful, and the service was excellent. We tried on several collars and finally decided on the ones we wanted. We ordered one online, and they sent it by registered mail super fast. The quality is great, the beauty is evident, and you can tell they love animals. They are exclusive and unique collars. We loved everything. We will definitely buy again. Thank you so much for everything!
Fun and beautiful handmade collars for dogs, handmade by the owner. A must visit place for dog owners.
